facts.claim: Majestic Princess (Princess Cruises): Entered service 2017; 143,700 GT; 3560 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 330 m length; Royal class.
Majestic Princess is a British-registered Royal-class cruise ship operated by Princess Cruises, a subsidiary of Carnival Corporation & plc.
